evidence.note: Introduces the Reasoning Score, a metric based on divergence between logits from late-layer projections onto the vocabulary space, to detect 'Reasoning Hallucination' -- logically coherent but factually wrong reasoning chains -- and pairs it with GRPO-R, an RL method using step-level deep-reasoning rewards to reduce it.
evidence.title: Mechanistic Detection and Mitigation of Hallucination in Large Reasoning Models
